item.title: About
item.description:
This is a sample About page for the hugo-theme-tokyo-terminal.

As a developer, this is where you would put your background, your passions, and a brief overview of your journey in software engineering.

The theme natively supports markdown, allowing you to easily write bold text, italic text, and insert code blocks:

def hello_world():
    print("Welcome to Tokyo Terminal!")
